quests.title: Necessary Procedures

dialogue.t: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogue.sit: Let's look for information on the Ministry's personnel transfers...
Let's look up the status of Feiyun Slope's water supply contamination...
Let's look for news about new business permit applications...

dialogue.t: "The Ministry of Civil Affair's personnel transfers are as follows..."
Hang on a minute. That's got nothing to do with business permits, does it?
I can finally rest for a while. Any more of this and I would have collapsed for sure...

dialogue.sit: What's with the huge number of procedures?

dialogue.t: Haha. Well, this is Liyue Harbor, after all. Contracts are of utmost importance.
Don't we all feel safer when all things big and small are written down in black and white?
Well, I say that, but this really is too much. I'm getting dizzy already...
So, did you find the bulletin concerning the permit?
Wonderful! Let me have a closer look...
Exit permit, business premises and safety certificates, and an old business permit...
That's fine, that's fine. I got those documents signed a few days ago, and that was an endurance run and a half.
Traveler, could you help me submit each of these documents in their turn as well?
That said... *cough* there might be a lot of people looking to submit theirs as well.

The <color=#00E1FFFF>exit permit</color> must go to Nervous An first. Then, the <color=#00E1FFFF>business premises and safety certificates</color> have to be handed in to a Millelith soldier named Jiayi...
Finally, the <color=#00E1FFFF>old business permit</color> needs to be given to Clerk Zhao.
Please help me hand these in, Traveler. I will be sure to arrange adequate compensation for you.
I really hope this is the end of all these procedures...
Well, you probably won't ever have to do so again, but as for me... I'll have to do it again at some point if I want to do business here.
*sigh* These methods do provide a certain sense of security, yes, but I do wish they could be further simplified.
The paperwork for these procedures is incomplete again...

dialogue.sit: Ivanovich is looking to get a new business permit...

dialogue.t: Ivanovich? Oh, yes, I remember him. He's been here a few times.
Applying for a new business permit, is he? Haha... he must be terribly busy right now, then.

You're here to help him out, I presume. Have you brought his <color=#00E1FFFF>exit permit</color> with you? I do remember telling him before that his paperwork wasn't complete, and that he needed to get it filled in elsewhere...
*sigh* These methods do provide a certain sense of security, yes, but I do wish they could be further simplified.
Let me see... No, this isn't correct. I only handle exit permits here. I'm not in charge of any other documents.
Let me see... No, this isn't correct. I only handle exit permits here. I'm not in charge of any other documents.
Let me see... Yes, this will do. I'll take this document with me, then.
Orderly lines please, orderly lines!

dialogue.sit: Ivanovich is looking to get a new business permit...
You're in charge of these certificates?

dialogue.t: Oh? You're here as his representative? I see. May I have your business premises certificate and... Uh, what was it again? Right — a business safety certificate. Do you have them both with you?
This one lacks a stamp, this one lacks proof, and that one's missing some information...
*sigh* These have to be sent back again...
Um, this is the wrong one. I'm only supposed to take business premises and safety certificates.
Looks good. I'll file these documents away and pass them to Clerk Zhao later.
*sigh* These methods do provide a certain sense of security, yes, but I do wish they could be further simplified.
So much material, so many files. Whatever will I do if I mix any of them up?
Hello. Anything to submit? Any questions?

dialogue.sit: Ivanovich is looking to get a new business permit...

dialogue.t: You're his representative? Alright. His <color=#00E1FFFF>old business permit</color>, please.
If you have it, submit it. I'll need it if you want a new one.
Mm. Good, I'll take this.
Have you submitted the other documents? You'll have to make another trip in a few days if you haven't.
Good. If everything checks out, the new permit should arrive soon.
I'll get someone to contact Ivanovich then.
This one lacks a stamp, this one lacks proof, and that one's missing some information...
*sigh* These have to be sent back again...
Have you submitted all the documents yet?
Phew, that's wonderful. As long as I get a new business permit, I can continue doing business here.
Thank you so much for making the trip on my behalf. Here, take this as compensation, just as we agreed.
I really hope that I won't ever have to work through so many procedures again... So tiring...
These procedures look complete...

quests.description: The storm in Liyue Harbor has passed, and all aspects of life within the city are slowly undergoing changes… For Ivanovich, this means working hard to adapt to said changes…
